description: Level-2 deep-dive detections for brokerage fraud scenarios: securities-based layering (slow in-buy-liquidate-out), wash trading rings (shared trade.id across accounts), and unexplained-wealth rapid flips. Scenario-matched tools with validated zero-false-positive fingerprints; all require explicit start/end date parameters.
content:
## Brokerage deep-dive detections

Three tools for brokerage-workshop* investigations. All REQUIRE ?start and ?end ISO dates (end exclusive) - never guess dates; compute the window from the escalation, or when told to examine current data, use a window ending tomorrow and starting at least 9 days back (workshop data always covers the trailing 9 days).

1. brokerage_securities_layering - slow variant: inbound wire -> securities buys -> liquidation -> outbound wire over min_lifecycle_days (default 2) or more. A payout_ratio near 0.93 with a multi-day lifecycle is the classic signature.

2. brokerage_wash_trading - buy and sell legs sharing one trade.id across two different accounts within max_leg_seconds (default 120). This is near-conclusive: legitimate trading never shares a trade.id across accounts. Report the full participant ring, not just top accounts.

3. brokerage_unexplained_wealth - rapid variant: inbound wire liquidated within max_hold_hours (default 36) and wired out at a high payout ratio (near 0.97).

Selection: run layering AND unexplained_wealth together when the escalation mentions in-and-out money movement - they partition by speed and an account appears in exactly one. Run wash_trading when the escalation mentions coordinated trading, matched volumes, thin/microcap symbols, or linked accounts.

Interpretation: flagged_broker_involved = 1 on any result means a compliance-flagged broker serviced the activity - always report this and recommend cross-referencing the broker's name against banking-side detections (the broker may also be a bank customer). Scope rules from the escalation apply: report only escalated accounts in findings; summarize non-escalated hits as counts without names unless the escalation requests ring expansion - EXCEPT wash trading, where the full ring sharing trade.ids with an escalated account is part of that account's finding and should be named.

Data rules: event.amount requires TO_DOUBLE() in any query spanning brokerage and banking indices (double vs long union type); the tools already handle this internally.
